method: Existing scripts/benchmark_orukeet.py with its loader replaced by the production local_transcription.load_recognizer; --threads 4; all four synthetic clips from scripts/New-OrukeetBenchmarkClips.ps1; one decode per clip per load cycle; process RSS sampled every 20 ms.
limitations: Synthetic English and Dutch speech; long clips repeat a sentence six times. Decode timings exclude model loading, recording, rewriting, and text insertion. First process load may use the OS file cache. A single desktop measurement does not establish minimum hardware requirements or natural-speech accuracy.
